pending-clause.answer: The flag fires on the word 'corresponding' (invokes pattern 'size error|arithmetic statement|corresponding'). Here it is plain English ('its corresponding formal parameter' of an INVOKE BY VALUE literal), not the CORRESPONDING phrase (§2002:14.6.5) and not an arithmetic statement or size error (§2002:14.6.6, §2002:14.6.4), so the changed arithmetic and size-error text (standard-binary/decimal modes, floating-point operands, near-zero size error) cannot reach this rule; scope and evidence unchanged.
